description: Budget-integrated foresight influences finance resilience investment and procurement.
Participatory model connects public voice scenario planning and accountability.
Distributed network channels foresight into policy review cycles and sectoral plans.
Local foresight affects resilience planning and community engagement but remains fiscally constrained.
Policy lab connects foresight to prototypes but needs stronger implementation authority.
Central foresight findings reach senior officials but have mixed budget and participation effects.
Outsourced foresight produces reports but weakly changes institutional routines.
Workshop insights remain mostly conversational with weak formal decision impact.
